title: Microsoft Teams: send chat messages while a file uploads in the background
summary: The briefing's default state and rollout windows match Microsoft's notice, and its roadmap details match the record. Hold because the statement that no prerequisite is documented overlooks the published OneDrive for Business requirement for chat file sharing, tied to the SharePoint licence.

claims.where: controls[0].ui and api; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: No tenant or policy switch for background file-upload behaviour is documented on the admin UI or automation surfaces.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams background uploads send messages admin setting policy PowerShell Graph; Teams background upload Set-CsTeamsClientConfiguration. Read settings-policies-reference, Set-CsTeamsMessagingPolicy, Set-CsTeamsFilesPolicy and Set-CsTeamsClientConfiguration; no switch.

claims.claim: Messaging policies control which chat and channel messaging features are available to Teams users.
claims.quote: Messaging policies are used to control what chat and channel messaging features are available to users in Teams.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMessagingPolicy lists no parameter for background-upload behaviour.
claims.quote: Searched: upload, attach, asynchronous, background and file in the fetched Set-CsTeamsMessagingPolicy reference. AutoShareFilesInExternalChats concerns automatic external sharing, not upload timing; DesignerForBackgroundsAndImages concerns images.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Change & support; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not described the interrupted or failed background-upload presentation in this new experience.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams send messages upload recipients failed upload background; read MC1317836 and Error when uploading files to a Teams chat excerpts. Existing OneDrive error messages are documented, but no new asynchronous-upload presentation is described.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not described what recipients see when a message is sent during a background upload.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams send messages upload recipients failed upload background; read MC1317836 and returned Teams messaging/file excerpts. They do not describe recipient presentation for this new upload experience.

claims.claim: No prerequisite is documented.
claims.quote: Users in private chat also can't share files because OneDrive for Business (which is tied to the SharePoint license) is required for that functionality.
claims.fix: Replace 'No role or prerequisite is documented.' with 'No administrator role specific to this change is documented. Existing chat file sharing requires OneDrive for Business, which is tied to the SharePoint licence.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/limits-specifications-teams#storage.

claims.claim: Files shared in a private chat or chat during a meeting or call are stored in the sharer's OneDrive for work or school account.
claims.quote: Files shared in a private chat or a chat during a meeting or call are uploaded and stored in the OneDrive for work or school account of the user who shares the file.

claims.claim: Channel files are stored in the team's SharePoint site.
claims.quote: Files (including OneNote and Wiki) that someone shares in a channel are stored in the team's SharePoint site.
